parsed.rationale: Both participating records in this cluster have `is_test: true` and reside in the same test file `Shared/Playback/Tests/MP3StreamerTests/AudioEnginePlayerTests.swift` within the `Playback` package. Although the Jaccard similarity of 0.769 indicates substantial structural overlap, the two methods — `testPlayIdempotent` (line 134) and `testPlaySucceedsAfterEngineTearDown` (line 365) — are distinct test scenarios: one verifies idempotent play behaviour and the other verifies recovery after an engine tear-down. Merging or deduplicating them would obscure the intent of each test case and reduce diagnostic clarity when either fails. Per the decision rules, all-test clusters are classified as intentional duplication.
